f59aee00a916248d7022042ff6cb62b68e94dd29.summary: A DataBreaches report, published 2023-12-03, on an extortion claim by the AlphV (aka BlackCat) group against Tipalti, a financial technology firm providing accounts payable and payments software. AlphV said it had exfiltrated over 265GB of data since September 2023, claimed an insider was involved, and planned to extort Tipalti, Roblox and Twitch. It posted no proof of its claims. Tipalti said it was investigating the allegation and had not detected any data loss or breach. The report stresses that AlphV's claims are unconfirmed.
